cases.name: composition candidate selection and commit
assertions: client-provided opaque session starts idempotently at request sequence one and revision zero
a lost Start response is retried with the same session identity and sequence
candidate selection uses a stable opaque ID
successful selection commits exactly once
composition and candidate state are cleared after commit

cases.name: paging and stale state rejection
assertions: paging advances revision monotonically
stale revision produces no editor effect
expired candidate ID produces no editor effect
candidate array position is never a selection identity

cases.name: duplicate response editor projection
assertions: duplicate request receives the cached transition
client reserves the response sequence before editor mutation
cached commit response is projected at most once
a contiguous response with stale or malformed state retires before editor projection
applied-response state is bounded per live typed session

cases.name: ambiguous editor result retires session
assertions: ambiguous editor result retires the current session
unconfirmed key streams are not replayed automatically
old response cannot mutate the editor after retirement

cases.name: host restart isolation
assertions: new host epoch invalidates all prior sessions
same-epoch transport session loss also returns stale session and opens a new identity
old candidate IDs fail closed
client clears preedit candidates and applied-response state
new input requires a new session

cases.name: UTF-16 caret and segment boundaries
assertions: caret uses UTF-16 code units
segments form a contiguous ordered preedit partition
segment boundaries do not split a surrogate pair

cases.name: password and incognito privacy context
assertions: ClipVault candidate surface is disabled
learning is disabled
no typed content is logged persisted or networked

cases.name: session cleanup and bounded response cache
assertions: end session wipes content-bearing state
response cache is removed after authenticated acknowledgement or retry deadline
duplicate request fingerprints never retain raw key text
session tombstones contain no input content and remain bounded

cases.name: single claim use consume and acknowledgement
assertions: one claim can expose one bounded mutable lease
all later use attempts fail
payload is wiped before terminal acknowledgement

cases.name: authenticated replay rejection
assertions: duplicate event nonce identity is rejected
same or lower sender sequence remains rejected for the session
independent authenticated senders have independent high-water marks

cases.name: monotonic expiry
assertions: wire expiry is authenticated before admission
one local absolute monotonic deadline is derived
retry cannot extend expiry
expired payload is wiped and never queued

cases.name: target and claim-context binding
assertions: wrong target is rejected
wrong nonce is rejected
claim context uses a strong sink kind and canonical opaque token
the same claim context is revalidated at secret use
stale or mismatched claim context is rejected before lease creation

cases.name: bounded capacity
assertions: global and per-target capacity are bounded
overflow fails closed without evicting a live credential
rejected transferred input buffer is wiped

cases.name: concurrent terminal operations
assertions: use acknowledgement dismissal revocation and expiry cannot consume twice
consumer callback runs outside the global store lock
detached lease is wiped in a finally path

cases.name: process lock and target cleanup
assertions: lock process-stop clear and target revocation wipe live payloads
terminal events do not enter an offline outbox
session replacement rejects envelopes from the old epoch

cases.name: cross-device transport fails closed before E2EE
assertions: unpaired target cannot receive an envelope
missing authenticated E2EE capability rejects transmission
local synthetic flow cannot be labeled cross-device Beta

cases.name: redaction and no persistence
assertions: OTP plaintext ciphertext and nonce are absent from repr and diagnostics
sender target and claim metadata accept only canonical content-free identifiers
no database file clipboard history or ordinary sync event is created
only bounded non-content diagnostics are allowed

cases.name: monotonic clock regression
assertions: clock regression wipes all live payloads
store instance closes permanently
new events require a fresh authenticated session
